definitions.explanation: Something that does not move or cannot be moved. Used both literally (not moving physically) and figuratively (firm, unwavering, established beyond doubt).

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{不動|ふどう}のエースだ。
{不動|ふどう}の{姿勢|しせい}で{立|た}ち{続|つづ}けた。
examples.english: He continued standing in an unmoving posture.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}にわたり{不動|ふどう}の{人気|にんき}を{誇|ほこ}るブランドだ。
examples.english: It's a brand that has boasted unwavering popularity for many years.

notes:
Frequently used as a modifier with の: {不動|ふどう}の{地位|ちい} (unshakeable position), {不動|ふどう}の{人気|にんき} (unwavering popularity). In sports, {不動|ふどう}のレギュラー means an undisputed regular player.

Also appears in the Buddhist term {不動明王|ふどうみょうおう} (Acala), one of the Wisdom Kings who is depicted with an immovable, fierce expression.

The compound {不動産|ふどうさん} (real estate, lit. "immovable property") is derived from this word.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{不動|ふどう}の{地位|ちい} — an unshakeable position
・{不動|ふどう}の{人気|にんき} — unwavering popularity
・{不動|ふどう}のレギュラー — an undisputed regular (sports)
・{不動明王|ふどうみょうおう} — Acala (Buddhist deity)
